implementation_branch.name: feature/sprint-21d1-learning-surface-emg
implementation_branch.not_created_from: sprint-21c3-reality-baseline^{commit}, so the C3 gate-close documentation stays in history
implementation_branch.carried_changes_note: Sprint 21D1 planning documents only; no source, schema or migration change was carried. They were uncommitted on the already squash-merged docs/sprint-21c3-gate-close branch, whose tracked content is byte-identical to origin/main (git diff HEAD origin/main is empty).

remote_protection.decision: No protection control was changed and none is proposed. Required approving reviews stay disabled because a second eligible reviewer does not exist; the limitation is carried forward, not worked around.

store_isolation.d1_integration_database_note: W6-F2 carried forward: the PostgreSQL integration suite TRUNCATEs every table it finds and gets a database of its own; the D1 evidence store is never nominated for erasure.

sandbox_and_scratch_roots.note: Only COGOS_ARTIFACT_ROOT is environment-configured. Sandbox and report roots are per-command arguments, so D1 declares them here rather than in the environment file.
sandbox_and_scratch_roots.scratch_report_root: session scratchpad under /tmp/claude-1000, never an evidence root

c3_source_pair_read_only.status: read-only source of inherited C3 evidence
c3_source_pair_read_only.access_rule: Read through raw SQL SELECT and file reads only. The application services log corpus_accesses, memory_accesses and experience_accesses rows, so C3 evidence must not be read through them.
c3_source_pair_read_only.backlog_gap: S21D1-001 names a D1 pair and the inconsistent development pair but not this third, read-only pair. Recorded here so the isolation invariant covers all three.

inconsistent_development_pair.remediation: explicitly out of D1 scope; requires separate operator authority

limitations.subject: review mode
limitations.observed: One collaborator; no second eligible reviewer exists.
limitations.impact: Required approving reviews remain disabled on main.
limitations.action: Carried forward and reported. No approval is fabricated and no protection control is weakened.

limitations.subject: reality-inputs-core check
limitations.observed: The job runs on every push but is not one of the 27 required status check contexts.
limitations.impact: A red reality-inputs-core does not block a merge by protection alone.
limitations.action: Carried forward. Promoting it needs separate operator authority and is out of D1 scope.

limitations.subject: inconsistent development Artifact Store pair
limitations.impact: The pair cannot be used for any D1 evidence.
limitations.action: Untouched, fingerprinted before and after, zero writes. Repair stays out of scope.

limitations.subject: OpenRouter free tier
limitations.observed: 0 correct results in 10 C3 attempts, nine adapter-boundary failures.
limitations.impact: None. D1 plans no live provider call and no provider is on the critical path.
limitations.action: No retry campaign. D1 stays offline.

limitations.subject: legacy recompilation
limitations.observed: The 60 C3 correction manifests use a legacy wall-clock created_at.
limitations.impact: They cannot be proven equal by recompilation; only source resolution is provable.
limitations.action: Every derived pair is marked legacy_recompilation_unavailable=true. No timestamp or manifest is rewritten to make a verifier green.

deviations.subject: scripts/postgres_bootstrap_roles.sh
deviations.observed: ALTER ROLE cogos_owner NOSUPERUSER is refused because cogos_owner is this local cluster's bootstrap superuser (pg_roles.rolsuper = true). ON_ERROR_STOP aborts the script at that line, so ALTER DATABASE ... OWNER never runs.
deviations.impact: The least-privilege intent of roles.sql is unenforceable on this cluster; the script fails closed rather than degrading silently.
deviations.action: Not remediated, identical to the recorded 21C1, 21C2 and 21C3 condition. The two D1 databases were created directly with OWNER cogos_owner, which is what the aborted statement would have set. Verified equal to the C3 database: cognitive_os schema, 114 tables, alembic 0015, cogos_app can read.

deviations.subject: database creation
deviations.observed: No repository script creates an evidence database; postgres_bootstrap_roles.sh only manages roles and ownership.
deviations.impact: Every sprint has created its evidence database by hand, which is untracked operator knowledge.
deviations.action: Recorded, not fixed in D1. The exact statements used are in the D1 report. A create step belongs to whoever owns the bootstrap scripts, not to a gate-blocked sprint.

deviations.subject: docs/sprints/sprint-21/sprint-21d1-technical-backlog.md and three planning documents
deviations.observed: The D1 planning documents were uncommitted on the already squash-merged docs/sprint-21c3-gate-close branch; feature/sprint-21d1-learning-surface-emg did not exist.
deviations.impact: D1 would have branched from a stale parent or lost the planning documents.
deviations.action: Fixed. The branch was created from the verified origin/main and the four documents were carried over unchanged.

deviations.subject: verification-logic extra
deviations.observed: z3 is not installed in .venv, and src/cognitive_os/verification/factory.py registers the four logic verifiers only when find_spec("z3") succeeds, otherwise register_unavailable.
deviations.impact: The 10 fresh logic pairs of S21D1-030..033 cannot be verifier-backed, and the registry snapshot hash would differ from the CI one.
deviations.action: Not installed in W0. It is a declared entry condition of wave W3b: uv sync --locked --all-groups --extra verification-logic. sympy 1.14.0, sentence-transformers and networkx 3.6.1 are present.
